notes.title: Patch notes v1.007
notes.notes:
Fixed a few small things, including:
 - The wrong scene occasionally being loaded when the game is quit to main menu and the same save is reloaded.
 - A few spelling errors.

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.005
notes.notes:
Fixed a few issues including:

Game crashing during some 7pm dialogue.

notes.title: v1.002 Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues, including:

- Some doors not opening when they should.
- Save files not deleting correctly under certain conditions.
- Some rooms incorrectly visible through windows.
- Spelling fixes.
